CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation linking to identified content's organization was present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) is given with explicit presentation (coordinate mapping) and a separate origin/status field for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No text links attention/allocation or processing condition to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color-labeled sets with coordinates) are present (example shown).

D.rationale: Origins/metadata (kinds like copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) separately mark status/source apart from content identities.

O.rationale: Content is represented as organized coordinate sets and candidate/global pattern assignments; presentation/organization is explicitly encoded.
